$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: A schema-invalid user_action_v2 returns protocol_error_v2 invalid_message

rejection.rule: V2 objects are closed: missing required fields reject the whole object. A known invalid v2 message yields a scoped protocol_error_v2 invalid_message and the last valid state remains. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §2, §10; protocol-v2.schema.json userAction)
rejection.effect: The phone sends protocol_error_v2 code invalid_message related to the offending messageId. The current coaching state is unchanged.

summary: A user_action_v2 object missing the required sessionId field fails schema validation. The phone MUST NOT execute it and MUST NOT clear valid state.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: A valid coaching state is applied; the last valid projection is established.
Required sessionId is absent. The closed v2 object is rejected by the schema. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §2, §10)

outcome: The phone emits protocol_error_v2 invalid_message related to messageId 99999999-.... The last valid coaching state (revision 1) remains unchanged.
